classification: DEVELOPMENT-ONLY EXPLORATORY — uses already consumed fit/calibration development roles; cannot create a confirmation claim; no result may select its own threshold, horizon or baseline after seeing the same score (every threshold is sealed here)

tradeable_move.definition: ternary on r = log(close[a+h]/close[a]) with SEALED round-trip cost c = 0.0010 (10 bp: committed env commission 2 bp/side plus slippage buffer): 0 if r > c, 1 if r < -c, 2 otherwise
tradeable_move.economic_interpretation: the minimal actionable question — does ANY position beat round-trip cost within h bars; class 2 is the no-trade answer
tradeable_move.distinct_from_failures: cost enters the DEFINITION (none of the seven failed regression targets had costs); close-to-close fixed-cost classes, not the unchanged intrabar vol-scaled first-touch barrier

mfe_mae_logratio.definition: log((MFE+1e-6)/(MAE+1e-6)); MFE = max(high[a+1..a+h])/close[a]-1, MAE = 1-min(low[a+1..a+h])/close[a], both clipped at 0
mfe_mae_logratio.online_computable: close of bar a only; labels consume (a, a+h] highs/lows
mfe_mae_logratio.economic_interpretation: reward/risk of entering now — sets bracket placement and sizing; costs shift usable thresholds, not the object
mfe_mae_logratio.distinct_from_failures: continuous path-asymmetry ratio from HIGH/LOW excursions — not a close-to-close return, not a volatility level, not a first-touch class

large_move.definition: 1 if |r| >= q_h else 0, q_h = the 80th percentile of |r| computed on the w1 FIT prefix ONLY and sealed before scoring
large_move.online_computable: close of bar a; q_h fixed from fit role
large_move.economic_interpretation: activation/sizing gate: is a move worth acting on coming at all
large_move.distinct_from_failures: decision-oriented exceedance probability, not the failed volatility-LEVEL regression

arms_per_candidate: constant/prior baseline (class prior from fit+cal, or fit+cal median for the continuous family)
target-history: regularized model on the causal trailing-volatility lags (barscale 0-3) — the shared causal scalar history, calibration-only hyperparameters
causal-linear: regularized model on the fixed 249-value causal summary of the 83 inputs, calibration-only hyperparameters

causal_design.windows: the four committed N2 development windows (geometry read from the committed N2 bundle ledger, digest-bound)
causal_design.per_horizon_purge: within every role, anchors with fewer than ceil(h/stride) sampled rows before the role end are excluded, so no label crosses any role boundary; h=24 additionally requires anchor+24 inside the frozen fit slice
causal_design.no_2026: structurally: only the frozen <=2025 predictor CSV is loaded; the sampled development anchors lie inside the pre-2022 o2022 fit slice
causal_design.multiplicity: Holm across ALL (candidate x model) contrasts (7 candidates x 2 fitted models = 14) via the repaired helper
causal_design.uncertainty: within-window circular block bootstrap on per-observation loss differences vs the prior baseline, block 6, B = 2000, seed 808, p floor <= 1/2001
causal_design.licenses: class families: every score window must hold >= 30 observations of each decision class (0 and 1); continuous family: finite losses and positive response variance; unlicensed candidates are reported UNLICENSED and cannot pass

decision_rule.candidate_passes_iff: EITHER fitted arm beats the prior baseline in all four windows with pooled skill >= 0.01 and Holm-adjusted p < 0.05

verdicts.TARGET_FORMULATION_CANDIDATE_FOR_FUTURE_: at least one candidate passes — authorizes ONLY a later confirmation design; opens no neural or GPU gate
verdicts.TARGET_FORMULATION_NOT_IDENTIFIED: no candidate passes simple baselines — supervised pretraining closes for this data contract rather than inventing another extractor
verdicts.NO_UNTOUCHED_CONFIRMATION_ROLE_AVAILABLE: reserved for a design whose execution would require an untouched role; this screen needs none (development windows only) — future CONFIRMATION of any passer will require genuinely new post-2026-08 data under a new order

execution_bounds.progress: per-candidate progress lines with elapsed time
execution_bounds.determinism: fixed seeds, deterministic solvers, complete per-window records persisted
execution_bounds.prohibited: no neural model, GPU, SAC, environment training, representation extractor, network access or untouched-role access
